title: Maraud
summary: MARAUD', verb intransitive [Heb. to rebel; Latin cursus, curro.] To rove in quest of plunder; to make an excursion for booty; to plunder.

inlines.v: MARAUD', verb intransitive [Heb. to rebel; Latin cursus, curro.] To rove in quest of plunder; to make an excursion for booty; to plunder.
